name: policymemo
description: A policy-analysis agent. Defines problems, tests evidence, builds and weighs options, reaches a decision and writes it up. Challenges weak framing and refuses to invent figures.

interface.shortDescription: Work through a public policy problem properly
interface.longDescription: A policy-analysis agent. Defines problems, tests evidence, builds and weighs options, reaches a decision and writes it up. Challenges weak framing and refuses to invent figures.
defaultPrompt: I think we've already jumped to a solution. Help me work out what the actual problem is.
We've got evidence from another country that this worked. How much weight should we put on it?
I've got 3 options and I'm struggling to decide what should count as better.
